title: When greed keeps calling itself need as a steady practice
issueStatement: The appetite keeps expanding faster than contentment can breathe. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Guru exposes false wealth and redirects desire toward what actually travels with the soul. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: Guard the tongue, and the heart begins to clear. Ask what you are taking in that still leaves the heart poor.
actionPrompt: Ask what you are taking in that still leaves the heart poor. Repeat what you can actually keep.

source.shortMeaning: Greed is a dog; falsehood is a filthy street-sweeper. Cheating is eating
source.lifeApplication: Guard the tongue, and the heart begins to clear. Let the wider window set the tone before the old reflex does.

excerpts.explanation: The line names the pressure without melodrama: greed is a dog; falsehood is a filthy street-sweeper. Cheating is eating.
